# Drop Cowboy

> The Communication Platform Built Around Ringless Voicemail. One REST API at https://api-v2.dropcowboy.com for ringless voicemail, texts, voice calls, email, AI voice agents and embeddable Building Blocks. Authenticate with the x-key and x-secret headers. Sends answer 202 (queued); results arrive on signed webhooks (and on a per-send callback_url when one is set). There is no npm SDK for this API.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/Drop-Cowboy/dropcowboy/blob/main/README.md): send a first ringless voicemail in five minutes
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Drop-Cowboy/dropcowboy/blob/main/AGENTS.md): the facts a coding agent needs
- [Vibe coding](https://github.com/Drop-Cowboy/dropcowboy/blob/main/docs/vibe-coding.md): MCP setup and prompts
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/Drop-Cowboy/dropcowboy/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): start from the symptom
- [Test numbers](https://github.com/Drop-Cowboy/dropcowboy/blob/main/docs/concepts/test-numbers.md): call and text +1 555 numbers for free, with no carrier, number, registration or funds; a team without a carrier or funds gets sandbox_only and can reach only 555 numbers
- [Starter CRM](https://github.com/Drop-Cowboy/starter-crm): the place to start for a CRM, or calling and texting in your own app; its Build with AI guide has prompts

## Code

- [Quickstart](https://github.com/Drop-Cowboy/dropcowboy/tree/main/examples/api/quickstart): one Node.js file, no dependencies
- [Node.js, Python and C# examples](https://github.com/Drop-Cowboy/dropcowboy/tree/main/examples/api)
- [Detect voicemail on a Twilio call](https://github.com/Drop-Cowboy/dropcowboy/blob/main/examples/api/README.md#detect-voicemail-on-a-twilio-call): call from your own Twilio account and play a message on the beep, in Node.js, Python and C#
- [Detection on Twilio Functions](https://github.com/Drop-Cowboy/dropcowboy/tree/main/examples/api/twilio-functions): two Twilio Functions that receive Detection events and respond to them
- [Building Block skills](https://github.com/Drop-Cowboy/dropcowboy/tree/main/skills)
